description: Land Acquisition - Werahera North, kesbewa D/S/D, Colombo District  Gangodawila, Maharagama D/S/D, Colombo District
categorisation: The gazette content consists of multiple formal notices under Section 7 of The Land Acquisition Act. Its primary purpose is to announce the government's acquisition of specific plots of land for a public infrastructure project (storm water drainage and environment improvement). It provides detailed descriptions of the acquired lands, including lot numbers, extents, claimants, and locations. This content fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4), which covers "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "Any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters." The content does not involve government personnel changes, detailed portfolio assignments, or any of the other specialized categories (Legal, Commercial, Elections, etc.) as its main subject.
